channel.title: Ahsan Mahmood — comparison guide
channel.description: Five routes to building software, checked against Ahsan Mahmood's work.

item.title: Five other ways to get this built, and how I compare
item.description: I am Ahsan Mahmood, an AI-native full-stack developer in Lahore with 8+ years of hands-on experience. AI agents write most of my code now; I decide what they build, review it and confirm it works. That is one way to get software made. These are the other five, including the jobs where I would send you to them.

item.title: Hiring an agency or hiring me — Ahsan Mahmood
item.description: When an agency is the better choice than one developer, what a team under one contract gets you, and what I do differently with AI agents.

item.title: An inexperienced developer or me — Ahsan Mahmood
item.description: When a newer developer is enough, what you take on when you hire one, and what 8+ years of hands-on work changes when the code comes from AI agents.

item.title: A vibe coder or me — Ahsan Mahmood
item.description: When generating an app with AI and no engineering background is the right call, and what changes when someone reads, runs and checks what the agents wrote.

item.title: A marketplace freelancer or me — Ahsan Mahmood
item.description: When a large freelancer marketplace is the better route, what its escrow really protects, and how you can check my work before writing to me.

item.title: Building in-house or hiring me — Ahsan Mahmood
item.description: When an in-house team is the right answer, where one outside developer fits before it exists, and what my handover assumes about the day I leave.
